title: Radio Management — Selecting and Cross-Checking the Second Radio Before Approach

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Crew procedure for setting up and cross-checking the two radio sets before the approach, including what to do when one set is heard weakly and how to hand the datalink path over to the stronger set.

sections.purpose: To give the crew a consistent way of setting up both radio sets before the approach and of dealing with a set that is heard weakly, without leaving the aircraft on a single set.
sections.description: The two sets are independent and each has its own control window on the radio page. In normal operation the left seat works the first set and the right seat the second, and the approach frequency is set on both so that either pilot can transmit. Reception quality is not indicated anywhere; the only way to know that a set is weak is to listen to it. Crews have reported that on some aircraft the second set is noticeably weaker in the last part of the approach, particularly in rain and in terrain, and the temptation is to put both audio selectors on the first set. That leaves you with no independent path if the first set fails, so it is not what the procedure asks for. Instead, keep both sets selected on the audio panel, set the approach frequency on both, and make the transmission on whichever set the receiving station is answering. If the weak set cannot be used at all, treat it as a failed set and say so in the technical log; do not simply stop using it.
sections.crew_procedure: During the approach preparation, set the approach frequency on both radio sets and confirm both are selected on each audio panel. Make one transmission on each set with the receiving station and confirm the reply. If one set is heard weakly, keep it selected, use the other for the working exchange and note the sector, the level and the weather in the technical log. If one set cannot be used at all, declare it failed, apply the dispatch consideration for the next sector and hand the datalink path to the serviceable set on the log-on page. Do not deselect a set from the audio panel to remove the noise.

type_data.crew_action: Set the approach frequency on both sets, cross-check both with the receiving station, and report a weak set rather than deselecting it.
